## Set up environment

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
#install.packages("remotes")
#remotes::install_github("crazycapivara/h3-r")
library(h3)
library(osmextract)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(mapview)
```

## Create gridded study area from point

```{r}
# Index a lat/lng point to an H3 index
coords <- c(51.512468,-0.117449) # lat,lng
# define resolution
res <- 6
# get hex id
hexid6 <- geo_to_h3(coords, res)
```

```{r}
# get hex polygon
hexpol6 <- h3_to_geo_boundary_sf(hexid6) %>%
  # add hexid column
  mutate(hexid = hexid6)
# get hex polygons with centres contained in a given polygon at res = 12
hexid12 <- polyfill(hexpol6, res = 12)
# get res =12 polygons
hexpol12 <- h3_to_geo_boundary_sf(hexid12) %>%
  # add hexid column
  mutate(hexid = hexid12)
```

```{r}
mapview(hexpol6) + mapview(hexpol12[1:1000,], col.regions="tomato")
```

```{r}
plot(hexpol6, border="red", col=NA)
plot(hexpol12, add = TRUE, lwd=0.05)
```
